column1: # claude-models.tsv: the specific Claude model versions llms.sh offers next to the
# aliases (sonnet, opus, haiku, fable). Claude has no command that lists its
# models, so this list is kept by hand: add a row when a model ships, remove one
# when it retires. Newest first within a family. Columns (tab-separated):
#   family   label   first-party id   Bedrock id
# llms.sh gives a row the Bedrock id when Claude Code runs on Bedrock
# (CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK=1 in the environment or ~/.claude/settings.json), else the
# first-party id. A "-" id leaves the row out on that backend. Every id here was
# run once with `claude --model <id>`; Bedrock ids carry a region prefix that
# depends on the account, and Bedrock names older models with a date and a
# -v1:0 suffix, so they can't be derived. To add your own, use models.d/claude.tsv.
